opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and certiorari granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded to Court of Appeals for further proceedings, including re-entry of its judgment affirming petitioner’s conviction and consideration of the appointment of counsel for petitioner in connection with seeking review in this Court of the judgment of the Court of Appeals. Doherty v. United States, 404 U. S. 28 (1971); Schreiner v. United States, 404 U. S. 67 (1971).
